# Anivora 0.1.35 — Cast entry and Profile corrections

- Replace the overlooked Anime Info “Coming soon” Cast action with a searchable episode picker. Select an episode and the player opens the real Cast controls after resolving a compatible online stream. Phone playback starts paused for this explicit Cast entry; source errors and ineligible/downloaded files show their reason.
- Keep all player Cast controls wired to the existing Android sender. A Cast request opens once for the selected episode, without reopening on every render or automatically following later episodes. No downloaded video or Render media proxy is introduced.
- Remove the duplicate TV pairing row from Profile. The existing top-right TV icon is now the only pairing entry, for both guests and signed-in accounts; sign-in continuation, QR scanning and manual entry remain available.
- Preserve download-first episode resolution, offline manga, the native HLS/parts/merge engine, Google profile pictures, remote avatars and six bundled defaults, server notices, Cloudflare pages and direct GitHub APK updates.

Android version code: **37**, newer than 0.1.34/code 36. Package:
`com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. The existing signing
certificate is retained; install over the existing app without uninstalling.

## Validation and limits

Release checks cover TypeScript, lint, Expo compatibility, app/API tests, real
screen entry-point fixtures, native unit tests, Android 14 download integration,
APK signature/version/architecture, compiled source and public download checksum.
Browser previews validate the episode picker and the single Profile entry using
mocked data; they do not establish physical Cast/camera interoperability.

Cast supports eligible online HTTPS HLS/DASH/MP4 streams fetched by the receiver
from the provider/CDN. Header/cookie-bound, local and embedded-player sources can
remain ineligible. Physical Chromecast/camera and Hot 50i certification are not
claimed. QR TV pairing still requires a future compatible TV client and a running
backend/database; Anivora1 was billing-suspended at release preparation. No TV
application is included.

See [Cast details](casting.md), the [pairing contract](tv-pairing.md), and the
[0.1.34 release snapshot](releases/0.1.34.md).
